work_packages.title: Specification consistency and normative registry
work_packages.acceptance: All schemas/examples/requirements/dependencies pass the independent specification checks.

work_packages.title: Pinned evaluation protocol and oracle custody
work_packages.acceptance: Model, package and runtime lanes have separate manifests and immutable task oracles.

work_packages.title: Machine arithmetic and error semantics
work_packages.acceptance: MIN/MAX/overflow/division/JSON-precision cases distinguish mathematical and machine semantics.

work_packages.title: Typed scalar IR and reference semantics
work_packages.acceptance: Independently authored all-domain boundary cases and unsupported nodes are handled explicitly.

work_packages.title: Resilient source-to-IR extraction
work_packages.acceptance: Wrong lowering/type/domain/branch is detected; extraction scope and source maps are explicit.

work_packages.title: Scalar obligations and actual solver route
work_packages.acceptance: Actual state/value relation; invalid branch/overflow mutants rejected; Unknown/missing solver visible.

work_packages.title: Evidence checking and artifact binding
work_packages.acceptance: Supported real evidence checked; stale/query-mismatch/forged claims rejected; no class inflation.

work_packages.title: IR-to-bytecode/Rust translation validation
work_packages.acceptance: Wrong generated arithmetic/error/order is rejected against independent source semantics.

work_packages.title: Reachable-state recovery obligations
work_packages.acceptance: Different reachable fault prefixes generate different state obligations; bad restore is rejected.

work_packages.title: Retry-safe input and external effect discipline
work_packages.acceptance: Unsafe action-before-ack retry rejected; accepted dedupe protocol proved under explicit persistence model.

work_packages.title: Recovery progress and fault-budget contract
work_packages.acceptance: Nontermination/fault-budget exhaustion and uninterrupted-progress assumptions distinguished.

work_packages.title: Mechanized source/IR/VM semantics connection
work_packages.acceptance: Actual preservation theorem or supported independent translation evidence with full trust statement.

work_packages.title: Restricted target machine semantics and lifting
work_packages.acceptance: Unsupported instructions/ABI/errors rejected; pinned target artifact model.

work_packages.title: Native artifact equivalence checker
work_packages.acceptance: Compiler/optimization mutant detected; required native relation checked for the supported leaf fragment.

work_packages.title: Finite graph and source-model relation
work_packages.acceptance: Witnesses replay and model completeness/bounds are justified; TLA/Stateright subset comparison.

work_packages.title: Target cost profiles and loop/retry bounds
work_packages.acceptance: Cost provenance/units/uncertainty explicit; expensive retries and unproved loops rejected from certified bounds.

work_packages.title: Joint finite probabilistic resource query
work_packages.acceptance: Independent exact/interval oracle cases; joint event and scheduler class; no marginal-product shortcut.

work_packages.title: Bounded relational verification
work_packages.acceptance: Two-trace secret/input alignment and quantified property validated; unsupported prefixes visible.

work_packages.title: Fault/effect/resource-aware regression
work_packages.acceptance: Equal-count logical weakening detected; old/new client domain and observable compatibility checked.

work_packages.title: Controlled language and requirement ledger
work_packages.acceptance: Typed templates/ambiguity distinctions; independent wrong-input/output and omission cases.

work_packages.title: Model adapters and locked-spec search
work_packages.acceptance: Same acceptance policy across model snapshots; failed budgets/forbidden spec edits visible.

work_packages.title: Evidence DAG and incremental invalidation
work_packages.acceptance: Changed source/spec/profile/assumption invalidates dependencies; tests cannot prove theorem roots.

work_packages.title: Typed runtime execution capsules
work_packages.acceptance: Executed bytes/profile/capabilities match accepted capsule; external assumptions and failure paths explicit.

work_packages.title: SWE-bench Rust and repository adapters
work_packages.acceptance: Original task/harness and denominators preserved; formal component coverage separately reported.

work_packages.title: Spec/code/proof benchmark adapters
work_packages.acceptance: Verina/SpecGym/vericoding/Vero comparison uses pinned tasks and declared adaptations.

work_packages.title: Soundness and semantic mutation harness
work_packages.acceptance: Independent valid/invalid/matched and equivalent-mutant cases; no known false acceptance.

work_packages.title: Fixed-artifact package performance harness
work_packages.acceptance: Cold/warm/incremental CPU/wall/RSS/certificate data; timeouts included.

work_packages.title: Native runtime and cost comparison
work_packages.acceptance: Matched safe Rust semantics; paired runtime/size/energy measurements and uncertainty.

work_packages.title: Agent-friendly CLI and Cargo experience
work_packages.acceptance: Stable structured outcomes, source diagnostics and explicit unsupported behavior.

work_packages.title: Closest-baseline contribution evaluation
work_packages.acceptance: Specific task/theorem/evidence or measured benefit compared with direct prior art.

work_packages.title: Extension process and supported-profile registry
work_packages.acceptance: Each new feature has semantics/encoding/translation/oracle/evidence/performance declarations.
